name: Tara Mingledorff
subject: SAVE THE NEW DATE: Fish Fry moves to 10/25
disclaimer_text: paid for by Friends of Tim Moore
body:
Dear Peter,Congressman Tim Moore's Fish Fry is moving from Thursday, October 15th, to **Sunday, October 25th,** with special guest State Representative Paul Scott. Please save the new date! Updated details are below.**Congressman Tim Moore 's Fish Fry
with special guest State Representative Paul Scott
Hosted by Maynard & Debbie Bradley**
Sunday, October 25th
5-6:30 p.m.
3253 Polkville Rd, Shelby, North Carolina
Donations are appreciated but not required to attend. [](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-r/) [PITCH IN FOR THE FISH FRY](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-y/) The support raised at these events helps carry the Congressman's message all the way through Election Day, and it means a great deal to him to see familiar faces in the room.To RSVP, email [**RSVP@CastlebarStrategies.com**](mailto:RSVP@CastlebarStrategies.com) or simply reply to this message. **If you can 't make it but would like to contribute, checks payable to Friends of Tim Moore may be mailed to PO Box 97275, Raleigh, NC 27624.**The change allows Congressman Moore to travel to Western North Carolina to support Jennifer Balkcom, Republican candidate for North Carolina's 11th Congressional District, at her reception with Speaker Mike Johnson.If your schedule allows, we encourage you to join us in supporting Jennifer:**Reception for Jennifer Balkcom with Speaker Mike Johnson**
Thursday, October 15th
6:30-7:30 p.m.
Asheville, North Carolina -- location provided upon RSVP
Attendee contributions: $125 per individual or $250 per couplePlease RSVP to Lucy Croxton at [**lucy@lucycroxtonconsulting.com**](mailto:lucy@lucycroxtonconsulting.com) by Wednesday, October 14th. [**Contribute online here.**](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-j/) Additional sponsorship opportunities are included in the invitation below. [](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-i/) [SUPPORT JENNIFER BALKCOM](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-d/) Thank you for your flexibility and continued support. We look forward to seeing you at the Fish Fry on October 25th!Thank you,Tara Mingledorff
Finance Director, Tim Moore [](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-h/)[](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-k/)[](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-u/)[](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-o/) This email was paid for by Friends of Tim Moore
PO BOX 97275 RALEIGH, NC 27624
[Privacy Policy](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-b/) | [Unsubscribe](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-u-fdklttl-hkhielhuy-n/)
